areas.limits: Pinned goldens plus seeded grammar-based exploration with bounded reduction of flags, patterns and subjects. Generated Linux x86 cases replay fully there; portable ASCII inputs replay elsewhere because upstream empty UTF matching differs by platform. Complete upstream dialect/JIT parity is not claimed. Linux ARM64 and x86-64 PCRE empty-UTF output advances bytes; the pinned macOS ARM64 PCRE output advances codepoints. An oracle-independent CLI regression preserves that contract.
Includes Git ignore/config, late NUL, transcoding and platform-specific contracts; exhaustive gitwildmatch/platform parity is not claimed.

areas.limits: 328 upstream valid named trees; no macro expansion or semantic type resolution.

Labeled pinned production-source and synthetic fixture evaluations verify pipeline precision/recall and independent-line discovery, not live-model quality. Request/token/cost accounting supports explicit provider evaluations. Shared Typesafe context and bounded cross-region line batches reduce transport/request overhead without skipping independent targets; fixture byte savings are not provider token-cost measurements.

areas.area: Decision budgets, cache, retries and cancellation
areas.limits: Provider checks use HTTP/native fixtures. POSIX interrupt cancellation is cooperative; Windows signal behavior is not runtime-verified.

areas.status: native-server and fixture tested exact scan
areas.limits: Explicit ID ordering from page one; native-server pagination, concurrent writes, actual cursor expiry, large region lists, API-key revocation and opt-in certified-trigram candidates with legacy fallback. Snapshot-bound cursors and request/document/source/output budgets remain required. No connector ingestion or direct remote-file downloads. Proven regex substrings and bounded literal unions support conservative candidate pushdown. Transient per-table statuses inside HTTP 200 envelopes retry the same snapshot/cursor.
JSON events expose schema version, provenance, source revision, index time, snapshot and observation time. Local sources are live; indexed sources represent stored revisions.

Paired elapsed/CPU/first-result measurements retain all trials and flag high variance. Native-instruction ARM64 Linux VM tests include cold advice, CPU affinity and worker sweeps on host-shared and container-local filesystems. Linux RSS uses separate GNU time command-maximum runs, not concurrent process-tree peak. Contended VM timings do not establish general Linux performance parity. Independent x86-64 hardware qualification remains admission-gated in CI; JIT growth requires a demonstrated bottleneck and equivalence evidence. Adaptive startup improves the measured small flat repository, but the larger SDK default remains slower than the saved baseline; explicit worker counts preserve eager startup. Earlier noisy and pre-workspace-correction reports remain available.

areas.status: bounded mutation and coverage fuzz campaigns
areas.limits: ReleaseSafe regex, Python/Go/Rust/JS/TS parser and dictionary targets have allocation/input/work bounds and leak checks; VM/JIT comparisons include spans, captures, marks, errors and steps. Finite campaigns are evidence, not a proof of safety for arbitrary input.
